newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil values held stable by thin activity.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil values held stable by thin activity.

text.p: NWE fuel oil markets were stable on Tuesday amid very thin activity.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $82.50 fob ARA in a lacklustre market, with traders balanced and unhurried.
Bunker demand was reported as moderate by some, healthy by others.
"Not everyone is convinced it's a sellers market, not yet anyway," said one trader.
Low sulphur sellers were gloomily watching straight-run prices bear down on cracked fuel numbers.
An Irish straight-run cargo deal at around $89.50 fob was only $1 to $2 above cracked values, though traders said prices for less prompt straight-run were around $91-$93.
The thin differential presaged a further fall in cracked numbers, traders said, with the main Italian buyer continuing to drive hard bargains.
